title: Last Light
description: Keep the lighthouse burning — sweep your beam to guide fog-lost ships past the reef and into harbor.
detailedDescription: An atmospheric arcade guiding game. You are the keeper of the last lighthouse above a reef graveyard. Ships drift blind through the fog toward the rocks; only your beam can wake them. Sweep across a ship to rouse it, then lead it with the light and hold the beam on the eastern harbor gap until it commits. Three lanterns, endless night — every wreck snuffs one. Fog banks roll in, storm surges shove the lanes sideways, and lightning reveals what the dark was hiding. Ghost Ships punish curiosity: light them and they drive themselves onto your island.
controls: Mouse aims the beam; hold left button (or SPACE) to focus it. Arrow keys rotate. Touch: drag anywhere to aim (relative), FOCUS button to concentrate the beam. P pauses. Enter advances screens.
